subject: Polaris Financial — IAM attribute mapping & admin roles clarifications
messages:
From: Sam Todaro <sam.todaro@polarisfin.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@polarisfin.com
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Polaris - IAM questionnaire: attribute mapping + admin controls

Grace — thanks for taking this on. Attached is Polaris' IAM appendix for the RFP (Polaris_RFP_IAM_Appendix.pdf). A couple of specific asks we want clarified quickly so we can progress: 

1) SCIM attribute coverage: we have several custom attributes (orgTier, costCenter, legalEntityId) and a request to sync nested groups -> tenant mapping. Do you support remapping arbitrary attributes and nested group-to-tenant transforms out of the box, or is that a custom engineering effort?

2) RBAC and delegated admin: Polaris requires delegated administrators limited to a subset of tenants and read-only access to production logs. Can you share how your admin roles map to least-privilege controls and any example runbooks/evidence?

3) Performance/TLS/SCIM limits: expected SCIM rate limits, patch support, delta vs full sync frequency recommendations.

We'd like to schedule a short technical clarifying call next week (options: Apr 6 10:00am PT or Apr 7 11:00am PT). Target to have these clarifications by Apr 10 to keep procurement deadlines.

Appreciate a quick reply confirming if you can handle the three items and what artifacts you can provide (mappings, role matrix, runbooks, screenshots).

Thanks,
Sam
Director, Identity & Access Programs
Polaris Financial

Attachments: Polaris_RFP_IAM_Appendix.pdf (96KB)

Grace / team — thanks, that plan looks great. A few follow-ups after a quick read of the CSV and matrix you attached: 

- Custom attributes: is remapping handled via config or do you apply transformations server-side? For example, we would like to concat attributes (legalEntityId + "-" + orgTier) into a single tenant tag at sync time. Is that supported without a dev change?

- Nested groups: if a user is a member of Group A which is a member of Group B, can you surface direct and transitive group membership in the SCIM payload Polaris consumes? We need both direct and transitive mapping for entitlement enforcement.

- Delegated admin example: can you provide a short example (screenshot or step-by-step) showing how to grant an identity admin rights scoped to a single cost center and deny access to audit logs? Our compliance folks need to see the controls.

If you can send those artifacts ahead of the Apr 6 call, that will save time. Confirm the 10:00am PT slot and please include a calendar invite with a dial-in for external participants.

Thanks — Sam

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Todaro <sam.todaro@polarisfin.com>, procurement@polarisfin.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Polaris - IAM questionnaire: attribute mapping + admin controls

Sam — quick technical answers and attached examples below. Long form attached as a small packet (scim_examples.json, delegated_admin_playbook.pdf) and a shared drive with JSON samples: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cScIM-samples

1) Custom attribute remapping: supported via configuration rules in our connector. You can define expression-based transforms (concatenate, substring, map tables) that run during delta sync. No engineering change required for most patterns — we provide a rule editor in the Console and a YAML-based policy for automation. Example rule you asked for (concat legalEntityId + '-' + orgTier) is a single-line transform in the CSV we attached.

2) Nested group handling: we support both direct and transitive membership. SCIM payload options: 
- directGroups: list of direct group memberships
- transitiveGroups: flattened list including transitive memberships
We include a group path attribute and membership depth if Polaris prefers to filter post-sync. 

3) SCIM behaviour & limits: 
- PATCH support: yes (RFC 7644 patch operations supported)
- Delta sync: preferred; default recommended cadence 5-15 minutes depending on churn
- Rate limits: default connector throttles at 60 req/min with burst to 120 req/min; we can raise for dedicated contracts.
- TLS/ciphers: TLS1.2+ required, we support cert pinning, mTLS optional for Private deployments.

4) Delegated admin model: 
- Roles are hierarchical but scopeable by tenant/costCenter/legalEntity.
- You can create a delegated-admin role with explicit allow list (tenant:X, costCenter:Y) and explicit deny for logs/audit_read. UI and API examples are in delegated_admin_playbook.pdf.

Attachments included in this reply: scim_examples.json (sample SCIM payloads showing direct/transitive groups), delegated_admin_playbook.pdf (2 pages; steps + screenshots), Redwood_SCIM_Attribute_Map_v1.csv (updated with transform examples), Redwood_Admin_Role_Matrix.xlsx (updated with scope columns).

We confirm the technical call Apr 6 10:00am PT — calendar invite sent separately. If you want a short dry-run of the transforms we can share a temporary sandbox and walk through two example users during the call.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
